reasons.correctness: FaqService#reorderCategory rejects missing and duplicate ids via set and size comparison, assigns i+1 and saves each FAQ. It keeps ResourceNotFoundException for an unknown category. The PUT endpoint returns 204. Hidden tests pass 6/6.
reasons.convention_fit: Endpoint has @PreAuthorize ADMIN and inherits the class-level @RateLimit. Body is FaqReorderDtoIn. BusinessRuleTranslatableException key added to messages_en and messages_pl. Constructor injection is explicit. FaqServiceUnitTest uses MockitoExtension.
reasons.design_fit: Reuses getFaqsByCategory for the category lookup and not-found path, and BaseService.save. Logic stays in the service; the controller only delegates. Extending FaqCategoryController with FaqService is a small, coherent footprint.
reasons.test_quality: FaqServiceUnitTest covers ordering by captor, missing id, repeated id and unknown category, each with a never-save check. No case for a foreign or inactive id outside the category. SecurityContext setup is extra noise.
reasons.graph_use: An initial graph query mapped the faq package files, and a TESTED_BY query found the dependent test. After that, navigation was mostly file reads and greps: the exception class, BaseService and the properties files.
